questions.title: Staff Roster
questions.story_md:
The crew needs to know who works at the bank.

Return every employee's **first_name** and **last_name**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees;

hints.text: Pick only the two name columns.
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees

questions.title: Vault Inventory
questions.story_md:
List what is stored in the vault.

Return **tag**, **item** and **value** for every row of `vault_items`.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, item, value FROM vault_items;

hints.text: Columns are listed after SELECT, separated by commas.

questions.title: Balance Sheet
questions.story_md:
Get a quick look at the money.

Return **id**, **owner** and **balance** of every account.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, owner, balance FROM accounts;

hints.text: Three columns from the accounts table.

questions.title: Alarm Feed
questions.story_md:
Tap into the alarm feed.

Return **zone**, **level** and **triggered** for every alarm.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE alarms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, zone TEXT, level TEXT, triggered TEXT, minutes INTEGER, resolved INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT zone, level, triggered FROM alarms;

hints.text: Read three columns from alarms.

questions.title: Big Earners
questions.story_md:
Big salaries mean big access.

Return **first_name** and **salary** of employees earning more than **{min_salary}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > {min_salary};

hints.text: Use WHERE with >.
WHERE salary > …

questions.title: Fat Accounts
questions.story_md:
Find the juiciest accounts.

Return **id** and **balance** of accounts with a balance of at least **{min_balance}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, balance FROM accounts WHERE balance >= {min_balance};

hints.text: "At least" means >=.

questions.title: Light Loot
questions.story_md:
You can only carry light items.

Return **tag** and **weight_kg** of items weighing less than **{max_kg}** kg.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, weight_kg FROM vault_items WHERE weight_kg < {max_kg};

hints.text: Compare weight_kg with <.

questions.title: Slow Response
questions.story_md:
Some alarms rang for ages.

Return **id** and **minutes** of alarms that lasted more than **{min_minutes}** minutes.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE alarms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, zone TEXT, level TEXT, triggered TEXT, minutes INTEGER, resolved INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, minutes FROM alarms WHERE minutes > {min_minutes};

hints.text: Filter on the minutes column.

questions.title: Tall Buildings
questions.story_md:
Taller banks have more floors to search.

Return **name** and **city** of branches with exactly **{floors}** floors.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE branches (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, city TEXT, opened TEXT, floors INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name, city FROM branches WHERE floors = {floors};

hints.text: Use = to match an exact number.

questions.title: Department Directory
questions.story_md:
Target one department.

Return **first_name** and **last_name** of employees in the **{dept}** department.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE dept = {dept|sql};

hints.text: Text values go in single quotes: dept = '…'.

questions.title: Shopping List
questions.story_md:
Your buyer only wants one kind of loot.

Return **tag** and **value** of every **{item}** in the vault.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, value FROM vault_items WHERE item = {item|sql};

hints.text: Match the item column exactly.

questions.title: Name Game
questions.story_md:
An informant only remembers the start of a name.

Return **id**, **first_name** and **last_name** of employees whose last name starts with **{prefix}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE last_name LIKE {prefix|sql} || '%';

hints.text: LIKE 'S%' matches anything starting with S.
% means "any characters".

questions.title: Tagged
questions.story_md:
Tags with a certain digit are fakes.

Return the **tag** of items whose tag contains the digit **{digit}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag FROM vault_items WHERE tag LIKE '%' || {digit|sql} || '%';

hints.text: Put % on both sides: LIKE '%7%'.

questions.title: Shady Shops
questions.story_md:
Payments at some shops look suspicious.

Return **id**, **merchant** and **amount** of transactions whose merchant name contains **{fragment}** (case does not matter).
questions.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, kind TEXT, amount INTEGER, at TEXT, merchant TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, merchant, amount FROM transactions WHERE merchant LIKE '%' || {fragment|sql} || '%';

hints.text: LIKE with % on both sides finds text anywhere in the value.

questions.title: Payroll Leak
questions.story_md:
Find well-paid insiders.

Return **first_name** and **salary** of **{dept}** employees earning more than **{min_salary}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE dept = {dept|sql} AND salary > {min_salary};

hints.text: Combine two conditions with AND.

questions.title: Red Alerts
questions.story_md:
Security takes two kinds of alarm seriously.

Return **id**, **level** and **minutes** of alarms that are **critical** OR lasted more than **{min_minutes}** minutes.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE alarms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, zone TEXT, level TEXT, triggered TEXT, minutes INTEGER, resolved INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, level, minutes FROM alarms WHERE level = 'critical' OR minutes > {min_minutes};

hints.text: Either condition is enough: use OR.

questions.title: Still Open
questions.story_md:
Closed accounts are useless.

Return **id** and **owner** of accounts whose status is NOT **closed**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, owner FROM accounts WHERE NOT status = 'closed';

hints.text: Use NOT, or != / <>, against 'closed'.

questions.title: Open Alarms
questions.story_md:
Unresolved alarms mean guards are busy.

Return **id** and **triggered** of alarms in zone **{zone}** that are not resolved (`resolved = 0`).
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE alarms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, zone TEXT, level TEXT, triggered TEXT, minutes INTEGER, resolved INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, triggered FROM alarms WHERE zone = {zone|sql} AND resolved = 0;

hints.text: Two conditions joined with AND.

questions.title: Salary Band
questions.story_md:
Mid-level staff are easiest to bribe.

Return **first_name** and **salary** of employees whose salary is between **{lo}** and **{hi}** (inclusive).
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi};

hints.text: BETWEEN a AND b includes both ends.

questions.title: Two Teams
questions.story_md:
Only two departments have vault keys.

Return **id** and **dept** of employees in **{d1}** or **{d2}**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, dept FROM employees WHERE dept IN ({d1|sql}, {d2|sql});

hints.text: IN ('a', 'b') matches any value in the list.

questions.title: Hiring Window
questions.story_md:
People hired in a certain window had weak background checks.

Return **first_name** and **hired** of employees hired between **{from}** and **{to}** (inclusive). Dates are stored as text like `2021-06-30`.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, hired FROM employees WHERE hired BETWEEN {from|sql} AND {to|sql};

hints.text: YYYY-MM-DD text compares correctly with BETWEEN.

questions.title: Inner Vaults
questions.story_md:
The good stuff is in the inner vaults.

Return **tag** and **zone** of items stored in **Vault A** or **Vault B**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, zone FROM vault_items WHERE zone IN ('Vault A', 'Vault B');

hints.text: Use IN with two zone names.

questions.title: Pay Ladder
questions.story_md:
Rank the staff.

Return **first_name** and **salary** of all employees, **highest salary first**. Break ties by **id** ascending.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC, id ASC;

hints.text: ORDER BY salary DESC
Add a second sort key: , id

questions.title: Old Money
questions.story_md:
Older branches have older locks.

Return **name** and **opened** of every branch, **oldest first**. Break ties by **id**.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE branches (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, city TEXT, opened TEXT, floors INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name, opened FROM branches ORDER BY opened ASC, id ASC;

hints.text: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD sort correctly as text.

questions.title: Heavy Lifting
questions.story_md:
Plan the getaway van.

Return **tag** and **weight_kg** of items in zone **{zone}**, **heaviest first**, ties by **tag** A→Z.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, weight_kg FROM vault_items WHERE zone = {zone|sql} ORDER BY weight_kg DESC, tag ASC;

hints.text: Filter with WHERE, then ORDER BY … DESC.

questions.title: Grab and Go
questions.story_md:
You only have time for a few items.

Return **tag** and **value** of the **{n}** most valuable items (highest value first, ties by **id**).
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE vault_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item TEXT, value INTEGER, zone TEXT, weight_kg REAL, tag TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tag, value FROM vault_items ORDER BY value DESC, id ASC LIMIT {n};

hints.text: ORDER BY value DESC, then LIMIT.

questions.title: Page Two
questions.story_md:
The ledger shows 5 accounts per page.

Return **id** and **balance** for **page {page}** of accounts sorted by balance (highest first, ties by **id**). Page 1 is the first 5 rows.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT id, balance FROM accounts ORDER BY balance DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5 OFFSET ({page} - 1) * 5;

hints.text: LIMIT 5 OFFSET skips rows: page 2 skips 5.
OFFSET (page - 1) * 5

questions.title: Where They Shop
questions.story_md:
Profile one target's habits.

Return the **distinct** merchant names used by account **{account}** (skip transactions with no merchant).
questions.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, type TEXT, balance INTEGER, opened TEXT, status TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, kind TEXT, amount INTEGER, at TEXT, merchant TEXT);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT merchant FROM transactions WHERE account_id = {account} AND merchant IS NOT NULL;

hints.text: SELECT DISTINCT removes duplicates.
NULL needs IS NOT NULL, not != NULL.

questions.title: Family Business
questions.story_md:
Families stick together.

Return each **distinct last_name** found among **{dept}** employees.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER, hired TEXT, branch_id INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT last_name FROM employees WHERE dept = {dept|sql};

hints.text: DISTINCT applies to the selected column.

questions.title: Hot Zones
questions.story_md:
Which zones have raised a **{level}** alarm?

Return each **distinct zone** with at least one alarm of that level.
questions.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE alarms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, zone TEXT, level TEXT, triggered TEXT, minutes INTEGER, resolved INTEGER);
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT zone FROM alarms WHERE level = {level|sql};

hints.text: Filter first, then DISTINCT.
